purpose: Attribute natural code-switch translation, name and empty-output observations by comparing the unchanged native baseline with an unmodified pinned Python reference across the entire original ASCEND test split
previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: main fast-forward delivery, exact-SHA CI success, Swift version annotation fix and remote verification completed
hypothesis: The fixed natural translation/name/empty cases may be shared model/reference behavior; native-versus-reference Mel/encoder numerical differences can independently change other outputs. Reference agreement alone does not establish correctness or eliminate numerical sensitivity.

data.selection: Entire original test split in metadata order, original PCM16 WAV; no resampling, gain, padding, forced language, retries, skips or output-dependent selection
data.attribution: ASCEND, Lovenia et al., LREC 2022, HKUST CAiRE

baseline.native_unchanged_condition: All Native source, managed SDK adapter, inference lock and packaged resources match the accepted Helper; current tracked source snapshotted separately

independent_controls.selection: first metadata row for language; not output selected

native_check.required: All 10 current native HTTP texts and language values must equal retained baseline before starting reference; a mismatch stops the study without retry

execution.request_order: Reuse all ten completed native controls after file-only contract-field verification, then complete Python reference once; serial maximum one owned model process
execution.model_hash_policy: Reuse validated fixed model identity; compare full protected file metadata before/after, do not repeat whole-model hashing

analysis.metrics: Reuse frozen author-tokenized MER and character distance with original normalization; raw/normalized pair agreement, better/worse/equal edit counts per language/speaker/session, empties and script triage indicators
analysis.independent_check: Recompute native and reference mixed edit distances with a full-matrix implementation over all 1315 rows; require native totals to reproduce frozen baseline
analysis.specific_examples: All four previously retained cases; no favorable subset replaces full-cohort results
analysis.performance: Python decoder timings are not comparable to native HTTP timings or microphone end-to-end latency

protocol_amendment.reason: Correct driver-only equality of variable HTTP metadata; retain original failed driver unchanged, no model/data/default change
